items.html: And it was likewise necessary to place the Parsa and to diminish still further the lights that come out through the Parsa. And the reason for this added diminution by means of the Parsa is not for the matter of the world of Nekudim itself, which is the world of Atzilut, but for the need of the world of Beria beneath it, so that it would be able to receive the light that is extended to it. And by this you will understand how there is a screen and a Parsa between Beria and Atzilut. Indeed, from Atzilut to what is above it, no actual screen is needed, but only a remoteness of place, which is the aforementioned restriction; for the light rose above the Tabur and became remote from the point that is opposite the Tabur and below, on the outside.
